name: Isla
inspect_text: Yourself. A cardigan with ink on the cuffs, flat boots, reading glasses pushed up into your hair.

name: Wren
inspect_text: Wren is six and a half. She sits very straight on a low chair with a grey rabbit in her lap, one ear chewed. Her shoes are off and set side by side on the floor, toes exactly even.

topics.label: Greet Wren
narrative_lines: You sit down in the low chair beside hers, leaving a little room between you. She doesn't look up right away, just turns her stuffed rabbit so he can see the fish tank.
Isla (to Wren): Hi, Wren. Looks like Rabbit's got the best seat for the fish.
Wren (to Isla): His name's Biscuit. He likes watching the snail.
She unzips the small canvas bag on her lap, checks a little notebook inside, and zips it back up.
Wren (to Isla): Today's Thursday, right? My dad brought me today.
Her feet don't quite reach the floor. Down by the chair legs, her sneakers are lined up with the toes exactly even.

name: Gloria
inspect_text: Gloria Santos has been at this desk for nineteen years. Her glasses hang on a beaded chain, and she is writing something in red pen with the phone tucked against her shoulder. She nods at you without looking up.

topics.label: Ask Gloria about Wren
narrative_lines: Isla (to Gloria): How's she doing out here?
Gloria (to Isla): She came up to the desk twice to ask me if today was really Thursday. I told her yes both times, sweetheart.
Gloria (to Isla): Since then she's just been sitting there counting the stones in the fish tank. The snail doesn't seem to mind the company.

name: Dr. Bell
inspect_text: Dr. Bell is upstairs, on a call.

name: Mom
inspect_text: Wren's mother is not here yet.
